'''March 2002 Ventura tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Ventura, California on 2 March 2002. It is known from Dunya Ertan's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3436">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-05-another-ventura-03-02-02d3436/ another-ventura-03-02-02], DeckTech (Dunya "Hardpack" Ertan, 5 March 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-05-another-ventura-03-02-02d3436/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 March 2002
* '''Site:''' Ventura, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 4
